newsitem.title: CANADA: AEC to issue units in pipeline division.
newsitem.headline: AEC to issue units in pipeline division.

text.p: Alberta Energy Co Ltd on Thursday said it planned to reorganize its pipeline division into a limited partnership and sell units in the business for C$10 each.
AEC said units would be sold in installments of C$6 at the time of purchase and C$4 in March 1998. The reorganization plans had been announced last year.
A preliminary prospectus for AEC Pipelines LP was being filed with Canadian securities regulators, the company said.

Under the proposed transaction, AEC's Canadian pipeline assets, excluding its interest in Express Pipeline, would be held directly in the partnership. The partnership would participate in AEC's Express and Platte pipeline interests through non-voting securities, it said.
AEC, which planned to use proceeds to pay down debt, said that it would own a 70 percent partnership interest when the deal closed.
The offering was being led by Scotia Capital Markets and RBC Dominion Securities Inc, AEC said.
